newsitem.title: USA: Leap Group forms Quantum Leap subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Leap Group forms Quantum Leap subsidiary.

text.p: Leap Group Inc on Thursday it has formed a subsidiary to help marketers communicate more effectively with consumers in non-traditional ways.
The company said it set up a unit called Quantum Leap Communications.
Frederick Smith, vice chairman and chief operating officer of Leap Group, was named president of Quantum Leap. He will retain his responsibilities at Leap Group, the company said.
Quantum Leap's projects may include, for example, developing distribution systems for the Internet or software applications to help advertisers, the company said.
